description: This file defines the ImpactProjectItemCost class within the Goteo project, responsible for managing the association between impact project items and their costs, including database interactions such as save, retrieve, and delete operations.

classes.name: ImpactProjectItemCost
classes.description: Class handling the relationship between impact project items and costs, with methods for saving, retrieving, and validating cost data associated with impact project items.

methods.name: getImpactProjectItem
methods.description: Returns the ImpactProjectItem associated with this cost item.

methods.name: setImpactProjectItem
methods.description: Sets the ImpactProjectItem associated with this cost item.

methods.name: getCost
methods.description: Retrieves the Cost object associated with this impact project item cost.

methods.name: setCost
methods.description: Assigns a Cost object to this impact project item cost.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the impact project item cost to the database.

methods.name: getByImpactProjectItemAndCost
methods.description: Fetches a specific ImpactProjectItemCost record based on impact project item and cost.

methods.name: getListByImpactProjectItem
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all ImpactProjectItemCost records linked to a specific ImpactProjectItem.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the impact project item cost has associated cost and impact project item.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes the impact project item cost record from the database.
